teacher_info.about_teacher: I have over 8 years of experience in teaching English, Japanese and Mandarin. During this time, I have primarily provided personalized language training for adults and professionals, covering all levels from basic to advanced. My teaching experience includes one-on-one online courses and small group classes, with a focus on practical language skills such as business communication, travel conversations, and everyday dialogues. Through extensive teaching practice, I have accumulated a wealth of teaching techniques and methods, enabling me to tailor course content to meet each student’s needs and help them make significant progress in their language learning.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
In my classroom, you can expect a friendly and relaxed learning environment. I encourage students to actively participate, ask questions, and not be afraid to make mistakes. I believe that making mistakes is a natural part of the language learning process and an important step in growth. I will patiently address your questions and help you overcome difficulties, ensuring that you feel confident and comfortable at every step.
Additionally, I place a strong emphasis on cultural integration. Understanding the relevant cultural backgrounds and customs is crucial in language learning.
